2608.06227.title: From Passive Mirrors to Active Agents: Holonic Digital Twins for Physical AI over Networks
2608.06227.paper_summary: Despite advances in artificial intelligence (AI) across multiple sectors, today's AI tools, including deep learning and generative AI, still fail when embedded into physical systems, such as robots and vehicles operating under real-world physical laws. This stems from their inability to maintain reliable world models for long-horizon planning under uncertainty and generalize to unseen scenarios. In this context, wireless networks, through pervasive sensing and communication, can orchestrate physical intelligence. However, current architectures optimize throughput, latency, and reliability and cannot support real-time physical AI coordination, requiring agents to maintain shared spatiotemporal context. To address these challenges, a network of holonic digital twins (HDT-Nets) framework is proposed to deliver real-time physical AI inference through holonic agents that actively reason about their environment rather than passively mirror physical assets. Each HDT is realized as a hierarchical structure spanning the physical agent and network edge, reasoning autonomously at the local level while cooperating with neighboring HDTs to form collectively intelligent units. In HDT-Net, causal Markov blankets spanning sensing, communication, and control determine which agents must coordinate and enable counterfactual reasoning over multi-domain interventions. Active inference within these boundaries unifies perception, action, and learning by minimizing expected free energy while deciding which beliefs to transmit based on their cognitive value to the receiver. Category theory ensures that transmitted beliefs preserve semantic structure across heterogeneous agents with incompatible representations. Finally, integrated information theory quantifies when collective intelligence exceeds independent operation and how network intelligence evolves through coordinated learning and information exchange.
2608.06227.paper_summary_zh: 儘管人工智慧 (AI) 在多個領域取得了進展，當前的 AI 工具，包括深度學習和生成式 AI，在嵌入到物理系統中時仍然失敗，例如在現實世界物理法則下運行的機器人和車輛。這源於它們無法在不確定性下維持可靠的世界模型以進行長期規劃，並且無法對未見的情境進行泛化。在這個背景下，無線網絡通過普遍的感知和通信可以協調物理智能。然而，當前的架構優化了吞吐量、延遲和可靠性，無法支持實時的物理 AI 協調，這要求代理維持共享的時空上下文。為了解決這些挑戰，提出了一個全息數位雙胞胎 (HDT-Nets) 網絡框架，以通過全息代理提供實時的物理 AI 推理，這些代理主動推理其環境，而不是被動地反映物理資產。每個 HDT 被實現為一個跨越物理代理和網絡邊緣的層次結構，能夠在本地層面自主推理，同時與鄰近的 HDT 合作形成集體智能單元。在 HDT-Net 中，跨越感知、通信和控制的因果馬可夫毯決定了哪些代理必須協調，並使得在多領域干預中進行反事實推理成為可能。在這些邊界內的主動推理通過最小化預期自由能來統一感知、行動和學習，同時根據其對接收者的認知價值決定傳輸哪些信念。類別理論確保傳輸的信念在具有不兼容表示的異質代理之間保持語義結構。最後，整合信息理論量化了何時集體智能超過獨立操作，以及網絡智能如何通過協調學習和信息交換而演變。
